स वश्यो दासवद्भूत्वा नान्यं स्वामिनमिच्छति
त्रिसप्ताद्रूपसंपन्नां पद्विभ्रान्तलोचनाम्

17.s:
urvaśīmapyanāyāsādānayetkimu mānuṣīm
anenaiva vidhānena vāyuvahnipurāntagām
17.d:
उर्वशीमप्यनायासादानयेत्किमु मानुषीम्
अनेनैव विधानेन वायुवह्निपुरान्तगाम्

17.s:
piṇḍākṛṣṭikarī jñeyā yojanānāṃ śatairapi
śaratpūrṇaniśānāthavarṇābhaiṣānusaṃdhitā
17.d:
पिण्डाकृष्टिकरी ज्ञेया योजनानां शतैरपि
शरत्पूर्णनिशानाथवर्णाभैषानुसंधिता

17.s:
vidadhyāttulāṃ śāntimātmano'tha parasya vā
drutahemapratīkāśā svasthāne saṃprayojitā
17.d:
विदध्यात्तुलां शान्तिमात्मनोऽथ परस्य वा
द्रुतहेमप्रतीकाशा स्वस्थाने संप्रयोजिता

17.s:
mahatīṃ puṣṭimādhatte daśāhenaiva śāṅkari
jambūphalarasābhāsāṃ vajrakīlakasaṃnibhām
17.d:
महतीं पुष्टिमाधत्ते दशाहेनैव शाङ्करि
जम्बूफलरसाभासां वज्रकीलकसंनिभाम्

17.s:
kīlane cintayedyogī mohane śukapicchavat
vajranīlapratīkāśāṃ pratisthānanikṛntanīm
17.d:
कीलने चिन्तयेद्योगी मोहने शुकपिच्छवत्
वज्रनीलप्रतीकाशां प्रतिस्थाननिकृन्तनीम्

17.s:
kālānalasamasparśāṃ ripunāśāya cintayet
mālāyaṣṭarabhītānāṃ kulamadrisamopamam (?)
17.d:
कालानलसमस्पर्शां रिपुनाशाय चिन्तयेत्
मालायष्टरभीतानां कुलमद्रिसमोपमम् (?)

17.s:
cintayeddhūmasaṃkāśāmatyantamanalākulām
śāntikarmoktavatkopapraśāntāvapyanusmaran
17.d:
चिन्तयेद्धूमसंकाशामत्यन्तमनलाकुलाम्
शान्तिकर्मोक्तवत्कोपप्रशान्तावप्यनुस्मरन्

17.s:
tāpane tu tathā kiṃtu svarūpaṃ sūryavadbudhaḥ
vidveṣe tu kapotābhāṃ bhañjane cāṣasaṃnibhām
17.d:
तापने तु तथा किंतु स्वरूपं सूर्यवद्बुधः
विद्वेषे तु कपोताभां भञ्जने चाषसंनिभाम्

17.s:
utsāde nīlaharitapītaraktāsitāṃ smaret
pratyaṅgavyādhisaṃbhūtāvekameva tadudbhavam
17.d:
उत्सादे नीलहरितपीतरक्तासितां स्मरेत्
प्रत्यङ्गव्याधिसंभूतावेकमेव तदुद्भवम्

17.s:
varṇaṃ vicintayedyogī māraṇoktena vartmanā
tadvattu śāntikarmoktavartmanā tatpraśāntaye
17.d:
वर्णं विचिन्तयेद्योगी मारणोक्तेन वर्त्मना
तद्वत्तु शान्तिकर्मोक्तवर्त्मना तत्प्रशान्तये

17.s:
cintayetkṛtake vyādhisaṃghāte sahaje'pi vā
athavaitāṃ japankaścidrāksiddhimabhivāñchati
17.d:
चिन्तयेत्कृतके व्याधिसंघाते सहजेऽपि वा
अथवैतां जपन्कश्चिद्राक्सिद्धिमभिवाञ्छति

17.s:
tadānena vidhānena prakuryādakṣamālikām
maṇimauktikaśaṅkhādipadmākṣādivinirmitām
17.d:
तदानेन विधानेन प्रकुर्यादक्षमालिकाम्
मणिमौक्तिकशङ्खादिपद्माक्षादिविनिर्मिताम्

17.s:
hemādidhātujāṃ vātha śatārdhapramitāṃ budhaḥ
yathā svabāhumātrā syādgalayākṛtitāṃ gatā
17.d:
हेमादिधातुजां वाथ शतार्धप्रमितां बुधः
यथा स्वबाहुमात्रा स्याद्गलयाकृतितां गता

17.s:
tāṃ gṛhītvā samālabhya gandhadhūpādhivāsitām
pūjayitvā kuleśānaṃ tatra śaktiṃ niveśayet
17.d:
तां गृहीत्वा समालभ्य गन्धधूपाधिवासिताम्
पूजयित्वा कुलेशानं तत्र शक्तिं निवेशयेत्

17.s:
pratyekamuccaredvījaṃ parābījapuṭāntagam
prasphuratkṣāntamekasminnādyakṣe viniyojayet
17.d:
प्रत्येकमुच्चरेद्वीजं पराबीजपुटान्तगम्
प्रस्फुरत्क्षान्तमेकस्मिन्नाद्यक्षे विनियोजयेत्

17.s:
ādyarṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ bhūyaḥ sarvādhiṣṭhāyakaṃ smaret
dvividhe'pi hi varṇānāṃ bhede vidhirayaṃ mataḥ
17.d:
आद्यर्णं व्यापकं भूयः सर्वाधिष्ठायकं स्मरेत्
द्विविधेऽपि हि वर्णानां भेदे विधिरयं मतः

17.s:
dvitīyaṃ vyāpakaṃ varṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ pūrvavannyaset
tṛtīyādiṣu varṇeṣu phānteṣvapyevamiṣyate
17.d:
द्वितीयं व्यापकं वर्णं द्वितीयं पूर्ववन्न्यसेत्
तृतीयादिषु वर्णेषु फान्तेष्वप्येवमिष्यते

17.s:
tataḥ śaktimanusmṛtya sūtrābhāmekamānasaḥ
akṣamadhyagatāṃ kuryādakṣasūtraprasiddhaye
17.d:
ततः शक्तिमनुस्मृत्य सूत्राभामेकमानसः
अक्षमध्यगतां कुर्यादक्षसूत्रप्रसिद्धये

17.s:
cakravadbhrāmayedenāṃ yadevātra prabhāṣate
tatsarvaṃ mantrasaṃsiddhyai japatvena prakalpate
17.d:
चक्रवद्भ्रामयेदेनां यदेवात्र प्रभाषते
तत्सर्वं मन्त्रसंसिद्ध्यै जपत्वेन प्रकल्पते

17.s:
homaḥ syādīkṣite tadvaddahyamāne'tra vastuni
viparītaprayogena saṃkruddho bhrāmayedyadi
17.d:
होमः स्यादीक्षिते तद्वद्दह्यमानेऽत्र वस्तुनि
विपरीतप्रयोगेन संक्रुद्धो भ्रामयेद्यदि

17.s:
tadā mārayate śatruṃ sabhṛtyabalavāhanam
abhimantrya yadevātra cetasā karma sādhakaḥ
17.d:
तदा मारयते शत्रुं सभृत्यबलवाहनम्
अभिमन्त्र्य यदेवात्र चेतसा कर्म साधकः

17.s:
rātrau saumyādibhede'tra bhrāmayedakṣasūtrakam
tadeva siddhyate devi kṛtasevāvidheḥ priye
17.d:
रात्रौ सौम्यादिभेदेऽत्र भ्रामयेदक्षसूत्रकम्
तदेव सिद्ध्यते देवि कृतसेवाविधेः प्रिये

17.s:
sevā cātrākṣasūtrasya ṣaṇmāsaṃ parivarttanam
vidhāvatra niyuktasya yogino vatsaratrayāt
17.d:
सेवा चात्राक्षसूत्रस्य षण्मासं परिवर्त्तनम्
विधावत्र नियुक्तस्य योगिनो वत्सरत्रयात्

17.s:
vāksiddhirjāyate devi sarvalokasudurlabhā
vāksiddhernāparā siddhiruttamā bhuvi jātucit
17.d:
वाक्सिद्धिर्जायते देवि सर्वलोकसुदुर्लभा
वाक्सिद्धेर्नापरा सिद्धिरुत्तमा भुवि जातुचित्

17.s:
vāco varṇātmikā yasmādūrṇarūpā ca mālinī
athavā cintayedenāmulkākārāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
17.d:
वाचो वर्णात्मिका यस्मादूर्णरूपा च मालिनी
अथवा चिन्तयेदेनामुल्काकारां विचक्षणः

17.s:
nirgacchantīṃ svakāddehāddisphurantīṃ tato'pyataḥ
sphuliṅgaiḥ koṭisaṃkhyātaiḥ saṃtataiḥ kiraṇākulaiḥ
17.d:
निर्गच्छन्तीं स्वकाद्देहाद्दिस्फुरन्तीं ततोऽप्यतः
स्फुलिङ्गैः कोटिसंख्यातैः संततैः किरणाकुलैः

17.s:
grāmaṃ vā pattanaṃ vāpi nagaraṃ deśameva vā
maṇḍalaṃ pṛthivīṃ vāpi brahmāṇḍaṃ vā samastakam
17.d:
ग्रामं वा पत्तनं वापि नगरं देशमेव वा
मण्डलं पृथिवीं वापि ब्रह्माण्डं वा समस्तकम्

17.s:
vistīrṇaṃ vā janānīkamekaikamuttamottamam
sabāhyābhyantaraṃ vyāpya punaḥ pratinivṛttya ca
17.d:
विस्तीर्णं वा जनानीकमेकैकमुत्तमोत्तमम्
सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं व्याप्य पुनः प्रतिनिवृत्त्य च

17.s:
praviśantīṃ svakaṃ dehaṃ pūrvākārāmanusmaret
evaṃ dine dine kuryāttadgatenāntarātmanā
17.d:
प्रविशन्तीं स्वकं देहं पूर्वाकारामनुस्मरेत्
एवं दिने दिने कुर्यात्तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना

17.s:
tato'sya māsamātreṇa janāstatra nivāsinaḥ
āgacchanti yathā tīrtha śaktitejopabṛṃhitāḥ
17.d:
ततोऽस्य मासमात्रेण जनास्तत्र निवासिनः
आगच्छन्ति यथा तीर्थ शक्तितेजोपबृंहिताः

17.s:
rūpiṇyo vividhākārā lalanādyāstathā parāḥ
bhūcaryaḥ kṣobhamāyānti ṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ
17.d:
रूपिण्यो विविधाकारा ललनाद्यास्तथा पराः
भूचर्यः क्षोभमायान्ति षण्मासान्नात्र संशयः

17.s:
yonijā dvā majā (?) kṣetrajātāḥ pīṭhasamudbhavāḥ
nāyikāśca mahādevi kramātkṣubhyanti vatsarāt
17.d:
योनिजा द्वा मजा (?) क्षेत्रजाताः पीठसमुद्भवाः
नायिकाश्च महादेवि क्रमात्क्षुभ्यन्ति वत्सरात्

17.s:
antarikṣagatā divyā brahmalokagatāśca yāḥ
brahmāṇḍāntargatāḥ sarvāḥ kṣobhaṃ yānti samātrayāt
17.d:
अन्तरिक्षगता दिव्या ब्रह्मलोकगताश्च याः
ब्रह्माण्डान्तर्गताः सर्वाः क्षोभं यान्ति समात्रयात्

17.s:
svaṃ svaṃ dadati vijñānaṃ sādhakena samīhitam
yadi tā na prayacchanti sādhakena samīhitam
17.d:
स्वं स्वं ददति विज्ञानं साधकेन समीहितम्
यदि ता न प्रयच्छन्ति साधकेन समीहितम्

17.s:
naśyate divyavijñānaṃ truṭyate kulasaṃtatiḥ
dattvā tu sādhakendreṇa prārthitaṃ phalamādarāt
17.d:
नश्यते दिव्यविज्ञानं त्रुट्यते कुलसंततिः
दत्त्वा तु साधकेन्द्रेण प्रार्थितं फलमादरात्

17.s:
anupālitagurvājñāḥ siddhiṃ prāpsyantyanuttamām
tābhyo vijñānamāsādya yogī yogikule kule
17.d:
अनुपालितगुर्वाज्ञाः सिद्धिं प्राप्स्यन्त्यनुत्तमाम्
ताभ्यो विज्ञानमासाद्य योगी योगिकुले कुले

17.s:
bhuktvā yathepsitānbhogānyātyante paramaṃ padam
itthayaṃ kathito leśātkauliko vidhiruttamaḥ
17.d:
भुक्त्वा यथेप्सितान्भोगान्यात्यन्ते परमं पदम्
इत्थयं कथितो लेशात्कौलिको विधिरुत्तमः

17.s: yogināṃ sarvasiddhyarthaṃ kulamārgānusāriṇām
17.d: योगिनां सर्वसिद्ध्यर्थं कुलमार्गानुसारिणाम्

18.s:
atha
viṃśo'dhikāraḥ
atha piṇḍādibhedena śāktaṃ vijñānamucyate
yogināṃ yogasiddhayarthaṃ saṃkṣepānna tu vistarāt
18.d:
अथ
विंशोऽधिकारः
अथ पिण्डादिभेदेन शाक्तं विज्ञानमुच्यते
योगिनां योगसिद्धयर्थं संक्षेपान्न तु विस्तरात्
18.m: Now the śākta knowledge is taught according to the divisions beginning with the body / for the yoga attainment of yogis, in brief and not in detail.

18.s:
piṇḍaṃ śarīramityuktaṃ tadvacchaktiśivātmanoḥ
brahmānando balaṃ tejo vīryamojaśca kīrtyate
18.d:
पिण्डं शरीरमित्युक्तं तद्वच्छक्तिशिवात्मनोः
ब्रह्मानन्दो बलं तेजो वीर्यमोजश्च कीर्त्यते
18.m: The body is called the aggregate; likewise, of the nature of Śakti and Śiva, / the bliss of Brahman, strength, brilliance, virility, and vitality are proclaimed.

18.s:
ajñānena niruddhaṃ tadanādyeva sadātmanaḥ
tadāvibhūtaye sarvamaniruddhaṃ pravartate
18.d:
अज्ञानेन निरुद्धं तदनाद्येव सदात्मनः
तदाविभूतये सर्वमनिरुद्धं प्रवर्तते
18.m: It is obstructed by ignorance, indeed beginningless, of the eternal Self; / for its manifestation, everything proceeds unimpeded.

18.s:
tenāvirbhāvyamānaṃ tatpūrvāvasthāṃ parityajat
yāḥ saṃvittīravāpnoti tā adhastātprakīrtitāḥ
18.d:
तेनाविर्भाव्यमानं तत्पूर्वावस्थां परित्यजत्
याः संवित्तीरवाप्नोति ता अधस्तात्प्रकीर्तिताः
18.m: Being made to manifest by that, abandoning its former state, / the awarenesses that it obtains are proclaimed below.

18.s:
tadeva padamicchanti sarvārthāvagatiryataḥ
tasmātsaṃjāyate nityaṃ nityameva śivātmanoḥ
18.d:
तदेव पदमिच्छन्ति सर्वार्थावगतिर्यतः
तस्मात्संजायते नित्यं नित्यमेव शिवात्मनोः
18.m: They consider that very [state] to be the word, because the comprehension of all objects / arises from it eternally, eternal indeed for Śiva and the self.

18.s:
tadeva rūpamityuktamātmanaśca vinaśvaram
rūpātītaṃ tadevāhuryatokṣāviṣayaṃ param
18.d:
तदेव रूपमित्युक्तमात्मनश्च विनश्वरम्
रूपातीतं तदेवाहुर्यतोक्षाविषयं परम्
18.m: That very [state] is called form, and it is perishable for the self; / that very [state] they call beyond form, which is the supreme [reality] beyond the reach of the senses.

18.s:
bhāvanāṃ tasya kurvīta namaskṛtya guruṃ budhaḥ
tāvadālocayedvastu yāvatpadamanāmayam
18.d:
भावनां तस्य कुर्वीत नमस्कृत्य गुरुं बुधः
तावदालोचयेद्वस्तु यावत्पदमनामयम्
18.m: Having bowed to the guru, the wise man should cultivate meditative realization of it; / he should contemplate the reality until [he reaches] the disease-free state.

18.s:
naivaṃ na caivaṃ nāpyevaṃ nāpi caivamapi sphuṭam
cetasā yogayuktena yāvattadidamapyalam
18.d:
नैवं न चैवं नाप्येवं नापि चैवमपि स्फुटम्
चेतसा योगयुक्तेन यावत्तदिदमप्यलम्
18.m: Clearly, with a mind joined in yoga, [he reflects]: 'Not thus, nor thus, nor indeed thus, nor even thus!' / until that very this is sufficient.

18.s:
kṛtvā tanmayamātmānaṃ sarvākṣārthavivarjitam
muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭhate yāvattāvatkampaḥ prajāyate
18.d:
कृत्वा तन्मयमात्मानं सर्वाक्षार्थविवर्जितम्
मुहूर्तं तिष्ठते यावत्तावत्कम्पः प्रजायते
18.m: Having made himself consisting of that, devoid of all sensory objects, / as he remains for a moment, trembling arises.

18.s:
bhramaṇodbhavanidrāśca kiṃcidānanda ityapi
tatra yatnena saṃdadhyāccetaḥ paraphalecchayā
18.d:
भ्रमणोद्भवनिद्राश्च किंचिदानन्द इत्यपि
तत्र यत्नेन संदध्याच्चेतः परफलेच्छया
18.m: Whirling, jumping up, and sleep [occur], and also a certain bliss; / there he should attentively focus his mind, desiring the highest fruit.

18.s:
tadetadātmano rūpaṃ śivena prakaṭīkṛtam
yatra tu yaccaṃ vijñeyaṃ śivātmakamapi sthitam
18.d:
तदेतदात्मनो रूपं शिवेन प्रकटीकृतम्
यत्र तु यच्चं विज्ञेयं शिवात्मकमपि स्थितम्
18.m: This very nature of the self has been revealed by Śiva; / moreover, whatever is to be known, although established as consisting of Śiva,

18.s:
tadrūpodvalakatvena sthitamityavadhārayet
tatsramabhyasato nityaṃ sthūlapiṇḍādyupāśrayāt
18.d:
तद्रूपोद्वलकत्वेन स्थितमित्यवधारयेत्
तत्स्रमभ्यसतो नित्यं स्थूलपिण्डाद्युपाश्रयात्
18.m: he should understand its existence by way of reinforcing that nature. / For one constantly practicing this, by relying on the gross body and the rest,

18.s:
caturbhedatvamāyāti bhaktyābhinnamapi svataḥ
sthūlapiṇḍe dvidhā proktaṃ bāhyābhyantarabhedataḥ
18.d:
चतुर्भेदत्वमायाति भक्त्याभिन्नमपि स्वतः
स्थूलपिण्डे द्विधा प्रोक्तं बाह्याभ्यन्तरभेदतः
18.m: it attains a fourfold division through devotion, although intrinsically indivisible. / In the gross body, it is declared to be twofold, distinguished as external and internal.

18.s:
bhautikaṃ bāhyamicchanti dvitīyaṃ cātivāhikam
tatrādyopāśrayādyogī sasaṃvittirapi sphuṭān
18.d:
भौतिकं बाह्यमिच्छन्ति द्वितीयं चातिवाहिकम्
तत्राद्योपाश्रयाद्योगी ससंवित्तिरपि स्फुटान्
18.m: They consider the external to be elemental, and the second to be the transmigrating [body]. / There, by relying on the first, the yogi, even while possessing consciousness, clearly

18.s:
bāhyārthānsaṃpragṛhṇāti kiṃcidādhyātmikānapi
dvitīyopāśrayāttattvabhāvārthānsaṃprapadyate
18.d:
बाह्यार्थान्संप्रगृह्णाति किंचिदाध्यात्मिकानपि
द्वितीयोपाश्रयात्तत्त्वभावार्थान्संप्रपद्यते
18.m: grasps external objects, and to some degree internal ones as well; / by relying on the second, he attains objects consisting of the tattvas.

18.s:
īkṣate ca svadehāntaḥ pīṭhakṣetrādikaṃ sphuṭam
svarūpālocanādasya yatkiṃcidupajāyate
18.d:
ईक्षते च स्वदेहान्तः पीठक्षेत्रादिकं स्फुटम्
स्वरूपालोचनादस्य यत्किंचिदुपजायते
18.m: And he clearly masters the sacred seats, fields, and so forth within his own body. / Whatever arises for him from contemplation of his own nature,

18.s:
tatra cetaḥ sthirīkurvaṃstadeva sakalaṃ labhet
tena tatra na kurvīta caitaduttamavāñchayā
18.d:
तत्र चेतः स्थिरीकुर्वंस्तदेव सकलं लभेत्
तेन तत्र न कुर्वीत चैतदुत्तमवाञ्छया
18.m: by stabilizing his mind there, he would obtain that entire [result]; / therefore, out of desire for the supreme, he should not fix his mind on that.

18.s:
piṇḍadvayavinirmuktā kiṃcitdvāsanānvitā
vijñānakevalāntasthā padamityabhidhīyate
18.d:
पिण्डद्वयविनिर्मुक्ता किंचित्द्वासनान्विता
विज्ञानकेवलान्तस्था पदमित्यभिधीयते
18.m: Free from both bodies, yet possessing some latent impression of them, / abiding within the vijñānakevala, [this stage] is designated as the word.

18.s:
yata etāmanuprāpto vijñānakramayogataḥ
rūpodayātivijñānapadatvaṃ pratipadyate
18.d:
यत एतामनुप्राप्तो विज्ञानक्रमयोगतः
रूपोदयातिविज्ञानपदत्वं प्रतिपद्यते
18.m: Because one who has reached this through the yogic path of higher cognition / attains the status of the state of cognition that transcends the arising of form,

18.s:
etaccaturvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ caturthārthapratiśrayāt
sa ca tattvādi force saṃvittipūrvastatpatitāvadhiḥ
18.d:
एतच्चतुर्विधं ज्ञेयं चतुर्थार्थप्रतिश्रयात्
स च तत्त्वादि fओर्चे संवित्तिपूर्वस्तत्पतितावधिः
18.m: this is to be known as fourfold, from relying on four kinds of objects; / and that [path] begins with consciousness of the tattvas and the like, ending with falling from them.

18.s:
padabhāvavinirmuktā kiṃcittadanuvarjitā
avasthā svasvarūpasya prakāśakaraṇī yataḥ
18.d:
पदभावविनिर्मुक्ता किंचित्तदनुवर्जिता
अवस्था स्वस्वरूपस्य प्रकाशकरणी यतः
18.m: Free from the condition of the word, yet slightly devoid of it, / this state reveals one's own essential nature; / therefore,

18.s:
tena sārūpyamityuktā rūpasthaṃ yattadānvitam
uditādiprabhedena tadapyuktaṃ caturvidham
18.d:
तेन सारूप्यमित्युक्ता रूपस्थं यत्तदान्वितम्
उदितादिप्रभेदेन तदप्युक्तं चतुर्विधम्
18.m: it is called 'having form' (sārūpya), which resides in form when endowed with that. / Through the distinctions of 'arisen' and the rest, that too is said to be fourfold.

18.s:
jñānodayā ca deveśi mamatvāttatphalapradam
amunā kramayogena antarā yeṣu saṃdadhat
18.d:
ज्ञानोदया च देवेशि ममत्वात्तत्फलप्रदम्
अमुना क्रमयोगेन अन्तरा येषु संदधत्
18.m: And, O Goddess of the gods, [when it is] the arising of knowledge, it yields that fruit on account of ego-attachment. / By this sequential practice, focusing within upon these [stages],

18.s:
cetaḥ śuddhamavāpnoti rūpātītaṃ paraṃ padam
caturvidhaṃ tadapyuktaṃ saṃvittiphalabhedataḥ
18.d:
चेतः शुद्धमवाप्नोति रूपातीतं परं पदम्
चतुर्विधं तदप्युक्तं संवित्तिफलभेदतः
18.m: the pure mind attains the supreme state beyond form. / That too is declared to be fourfold through the divisions of the fruits of consciousness.

18.s:
trividhaṃ tatsamabhyasya sarvasiddhiphalecchayā
caturthāttu tanuṃ vyaktavā tatkṣaṇādapavṛjyate
18.d:
त्रिविधं तत्समभ्यस्य सर्वसिद्धिफलेच्छया
चतुर्थात्तु तनुं व्यक्तवा तत्क्षणादपवृज्यते
18.m: Having practiced the threefold [form of] that, desiring the fruit of all attainments, / abandoning the body from the fourth, he is liberated in that very instant.

18.s:
iti piṇḍādibhedena śivajñānamudāhṛtam
yogābhyāsavidhānena mantravidyāgaṇaṃ śṛṇu
18.d:
इति पिण्डादिभेदेन शिवज्ञानमुदाहृतम्
योगाभ्यासविधानेन मन्त्रविद्यागणं शृणु
18.m: Thus the knowledge of Śiva has been taught through the divisions of body and the rest. / Listen to the group of mantras and Vidyās according to the rule of yogic practice.

18.s:
pūrvoktavidhisaṃnaddhaḥ pradeśe pūrvacodite
nābhyādipañcadeśānāṃ parārṇa kvāpi cintayan
18.d:
पूर्वोक्तविधिसंनद्धः प्रदेशे पूर्वचोदिते
नाभ्यादिपञ्चदेशानां परार्ण क्वापि चिन्तयन्
18.m: Equipped with the aforementioned rules, in the place previously prescribed, / he should meditate anywhere upon the supreme phoneme in one of the five locations beginning with the navel,

18.s:
svarūpeṇa prabhābhāramakāśitatanūdaram
dīptibhistasya tīvrābhirābrahmabhuvanaṃ tataḥ
18.d:
स्वरूपेण प्रभाभारमकाशिततनूदरम्
दीप्तिभिस्तस्य तीव्राभिराब्रह्मभुवनं ततः
18.m: illuminating the interior of the body with an abundance of light through its essential nature; / then, with its intense radiances, [illuminating] up to the world of Brahmā.

18.s:
evaṃ saṃsmaratastasya divasaiḥ saptabhiḥ priye
rudraśaktisamāveśaḥ sumahānsaṃprajāyate
18.d:
एवं संस्मरतस्तस्य दिवसैः सप्तभिः प्रिये
रुद्रशक्तिसमावेशः सुमहान्संप्रजायते
18.m: For him who contemplates thus, O beloved, within seven days / a very great absorption into Rudra's power arises.

18.s:
āviṣṭo bahuvākyāni saṃskṛtādīni jalpati
mahāhāsyaṃ tathā geyaṃ śivāruditameva ca
18.d:
आविष्टो बहुवाक्यानि संस्कृतादीनि जल्पति
महाहास्यं तथा गेयं शिवारुदितमेव च
18.m: Possessed, he babbles many words in Sanskrit and other tongues; / he engages in loud laughter, as well as singing and weeping directed to Śiva.

18.s:
karotyāviṣṭacittastu na tu jānāti kiṃcana
māsenaivaṃ yadā yukto yatra yatrāvalokayet
18.d:
करोत्याविष्टचित्तस्तु न तु जानाति किंचन
मासेनैवं यदा युक्तो यत्र यत्रावलोकयेत्
18.m: With his mind possessed, he does this, yet he knows nothing at all. / When he is freed in this way after a month, wherever he looks,

18.s:
tatra tatra diśaḥ sarvā īkṣate kiraṇākulāḥ
yāṃ yāmeva diśaṃ ṣaḍbhirmāsairyuktastu vīkṣate
18.d:
तत्र तत्र दिशः सर्वा ईक्षते किरणाकुलाः
यां यामेव दिशं षड्भिर्मासैर्युक्तस्तु वीक्षते
18.m: there he sees all directions filled with rays of light. / In whichever direction he looks when endowed [with this practice] after six months,

18.s:
nānākārāṇi rūpāṇi tasyāṃ tasyāṃ prapaśyati
na teṣu saṃdadheccetaḥ na cābhyāsaṃ parityajet
18.d:
नानाकाराणि रूपाणि तस्यां तस्यां प्रपश्यति
न तेषु संदधेच्चेतः न चाभ्यासं परित्यजेत्
18.m: he sees forms of various appearances in each of those [directions]. / He should not fix his mind on them, nor should he abandon the practice.

18.s:
kurvannetadvidhaṃ yogī bhīrurunmattako bhavet
vīraḥ śaktiṃ punaryāti pramādāccyuto'pi san
18.d:
कुर्वन्नेतद्विधं योगी भीरुरुन्मत्तको भवेत्
वीरः शक्तिं पुनर्याति प्रमादाच्च्युतोऽपि सन्
18.m: Performing this sort of [practice], a timid yogi becomes insane; / a heroic one, even if fallen into that through negligence, returns to power.

18.s:
vatsarādyogasaṃsiddhiṃ prāpnoti manasepsitām
parāparāmathaitasyā aparā vā yathecchayā
18.d:
वत्सराद्योगसंसिद्धिं प्राप्नोति मनसेप्सिताम्
परापरामथैतस्या अपरा वा यथेच्छया
18.m: After a year, he attains the yogic attainment desired by his mind: / the supreme-non-supreme, or the non-supreme of this, according to his desire.

18.s:
sadbhāvaṃ mātṛsaṃghasya hṛdayaṃ bhairavasya vā
navātmānamapi dhyāyedratiśekharameva vā
18.d:
सद्भावं मातृसंघस्य हृदयं भैरवस्य वा
नवात्मानमपि ध्यायेद्रतिशेखरमेव वा
18.m: He may meditate upon the reality of the troop of Mothers, or the Heart of Bhairava, / or Navātman, or Ratiśekhara,

18.s:
aghoryādyaṣṭakaṃ vāpi māheśyādikameva vā
amṛtādiprabhedena rudrānvā śaktayo'pi vā
18.d:
अघोर्याद्यष्टकं वापि माहेश्यादिकमेव वा
अमृतादिप्रभेदेन रुद्रान्वा शक्तयोऽपि वा
18.m: or the octad beginning with Aghorī, or that beginning with Māheśī, / or the Rudras or the powers differentiated by Amṛta and the rest.

18.s:
sarve tulyabalāḥ proktā rudraśaktisamudbhavāḥ
athavāmṛtapūrṇānāṃ prabhedaḥ procyate paraḥ
18.d:
सर्वे तुल्यबलाः प्रोक्ता रुद्रशक्तिसमुद्भवाः
अथवामृतपूर्णानां प्रभेदः प्रोच्यते परः
18.m: All are declared to possess equal power, originating from Rudra's power. / Alternatively, another division of those filled with nectar is taught:

18.s:
prāṇasthaṃ parayākrāntaṃ pratyekamapi dīpitam
vidyāṃ prakalpayenmantraṃ prāṇākrāntaṃ parāsanam
18.d:
प्राणस्थं परयाक्रान्तं प्रत्येकमपि दीपितम्
विद्यां प्रकल्पयेन्मन्त्रं प्राणाक्रान्तं परासनम्
18.m: residing in the vital breath, pervaded by the supreme [power], each individually illuminated. / He should project the Vidyā and the mantra, pervaded by the breath, as the supreme seat.

18.s:
dvādaśārasya cakrasya ṣoḍaśārasya vā smaret
aṣṭārasyātha vā devi tasya tredhā śatasya vā
18.d:
द्वादशारस्य चक्रस्य षोडशारस्य वा स्मरेत्
अष्टारस्याथ वा देवि तस्य त्रेधा शतस्य वा
18.m: He should recollect [it] in a wheel of twelve spokes, or of sixteen spokes, / or of eight spokes, O Goddess, or of a hundred and three,

18.s:
ṣaḍarasyātha vā mantrī yathā sarvaṃ tathā śṛṇu
saṃkṣepādidamākhyātaṃ sārdhaṃ cakraśatadvayam
18.d:
षडरस्याथ वा मन्त्री यथा सर्वं तथा शृणु
संक्षेपादिदमाख्यातं सार्धं चक्रशतद्वयम्
18.m: or in one of six spokes, O practitioner of mantras; listen to how it all is. / In brief, this [system of] two hundred and fifty wheels has been declared.

18.s:
etattriguṇatāṃ yāti strīpuṃyāmalabhedataḥ
śāntyādikarmabhedena pratyekaṃ dvādaśātmatām
18.d:
एतत्त्रिगुणतां याति स्त्रीपुंयामलभेदतः
शान्त्यादिकर्मभेदेन प्रत्येकं द्वादशात्मताम्
18.m: This becomes threefold through the distinction of female, male, and couple (yāmala); / through the distinction of rites such as pacification, each [wheel] has twelve natures.

18.s:
dakṣaścaṇḍo haraḥ śauṇḍī pramatho bhīmamanmathau
śakuniḥ sumatirnando gopāḷo'tha pitāmahaḥ
18.d:
दक्षश्चण्डो हरः शौण्डी प्रमथो भीममन्मथौ
शकुनिः सुमतिर्नन्दो गोपाऌओऽथ पितामहः
18.m: Dakṣa, Caṇḍa, Hara, Śauṇḍī, Pramatha, Bhīma, Manmatha, / Śakuni, Sumati, Nanda, Gopāla, and Pitāmaha;

18.s:
nandā bhadrā jayā kālī karālī vikṛtānanā
kroṣṭukī bhīmamudrā ca vāyuvegā hayānanā
18.d:
नन्दा भद्रा जया काली कराली विकृतानना
क्रोष्टुकी भीममुद्रा च वायुवेगा हयानना
18.m: Nandā, Bhadrā, Jayā, Kālī, Karālī, Vikṛtānanā, / Kroṣṭakī, Bhīmamudrā, Vāyuvegā, Hayānanā,

18.s:
gambhīrā ghoṣaṇī caiva dvādaśaitāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
āgneyyādicatuṣkoṇā brahmāṇyādyā api priye
18.d:
गम्भीरा घोषणी चैव द्वादशैताः प्रकीर्तिताः
आग्नेय्यादिचतुष्कोणा ब्रह्माण्याद्या अपि प्रिये
18.m: Gambhīrā, and Ghoṣaṇī: these twelve are celebrated. / In the four corners beginning with the southeast, [reside] Brahmāṇī and the others, O beloved:

18.s:
siddhirṛddhistathā lakṣmīrdīptirmālā śikhā śivā
sumukhī vāmanī nandā harikeśī hayānanā
18.d:
सिद्धिरृद्धिस्तथा लक्ष्मीर्दीप्तिर्माला शिखा शिवा
सुमुखी वामनी नन्दा हरिकेशी हयानना
18.m: Siddhi, Ṛddhi, as well as Lakṣmī, Dīpti, Mālā, Śikhā, Śivā, / Sumukhī, Vāmanī, Nandā, Harikeśī, Hayānanā,

18.s:
viśveśī ca sumākhyā ca etā vā dvādaśa kramāt
etāsāṃ vācakā jñeyāḥ svarāḥ ṣaṇḍhavivarjitāḥ
18.d:
विश्वेशी च सुमाख्या च एता वा द्वादश क्रमात्
एतासां वाचका ज्ञेयाः स्वराः षण्ढविवर्जिताः
18.m: Viśveśī, and Sumākhyā; or these twelve in sequence. / The vowels, excluding the neuter ones, are to be known as their designators.

18.s:
ṣoḍaśāre'mṛtādyāśca strīpuṃpāṭhannabhedataḥ
śrīkaṇṭho'nantasūkṣmau ca trimūrtiḥ śarvarīśvaraḥ
18.d:
षोडशारेऽमृताद्याश्च स्त्रीपुंपाठन्नभेदतः
श्रीकण्ठोऽनन्तसूक्ष्मौ च त्रिमूर्तिः शर्वरीश्वरः
18.m: In the sixteen-spoked [wheel], Amṛta and the rest [reside], through the distinction of female and male recitation: / Śrīkaṇṭha, Ananta, Sūkṣma, Trimūrti, Śarvarīśvara,

18.s:
ardheśo bhārabhūtiśca sthitiḥ sthāṇvīrastathā
jhiṇṭhīśo bhautikaścaiva sadyojātastathāparaḥ
18.d:
अर्धेशो भारभूतिश्च स्थितिः स्थाण्वीरस्तथा
झिण्ठीशो भौतिकश्चैव सद्योजातस्तथापरः
18.m: Argheśa, Bhārabhūti, Sthiti, Sthāṇu, Hara, / Jhiṇṭhīśa, Bhautika, Sadyojāta, and another,

18.s:
anugraheśvaraḥ krūro mahāseno'tha ṣoḍaśa
siddhirṛddhirdyutirlakṣmīrmedhā kāntiḥ svadhā dhṛtiḥ
18.d:
अनुग्रहेश्वरः क्रूरो महासेनोऽथ षोडश
सिद्धिरृद्धिर्द्युतिर्लक्ष्मीर्मेधा कान्तिः स्वधा धृतिः
18.m: Anugraheśvara, Krūra, and Mahāsena as the sixteenth; / Siddhi, Ṛddhi, Dyuti, Lakṣmī, Medhā, Kānti, Svadhā, Dhṛti,

18.s:
dīptiḥ puṣṭirmatiḥ kīrtiḥ saṃsthitiḥ sugatiḥ smṛtiḥ
suprabhā ṣoḍaśī ceti śrīkaṇṭhādikaśaktayaḥ
18.d:
दीप्तिः पुष्टिर्मतिः कीर्तिः संस्थितिः सुगतिः स्मृतिः
सुप्रभा षोडशी चेति श्रीकण्ठादिकशक्तयः
18.m: Dīpti, Puṣṭi, Mati, Kīrti, Saṃsthiti, Sugati, Smṛti, / and Suprabhā as the sixteenth: these are the powers of Śrīkaṇṭha and the others.

18.s:
ṣoḍaśāre svarā jñeyā vācakatvena sarvataḥ
aghorādyāstathāṣṭāre aghoryādyāśca devatāḥ
18.d:
षोडशारे स्वरा ज्ञेया वाचकत्वेन सर्वतः
अघोराद्यास्तथाष्टारे अघोर्याद्याश्च देवताः
18.m: In the sixteen-spoked [wheel], the vowels everywhere are to be known as designators. / Likewise in the eight-spoked [wheel], the deities beginning with Aghora and those beginning with Aghorī [reside],

18.s:
māheśyādyāstathā devi caturviṃśatyataḥ śṛṇu
nandādikāḥ kramātsarvā brahmāṇyādyāstathaiva ca
18.d:
माहेश्याद्यास्तथा देवि चतुर्विंशत्यतः शृणु
नन्दादिकाः क्रमात्सर्वा ब्रह्माण्याद्यास्तथैव च
18.m: as well as those beginning with Māheśī, O Goddess. Now hear of the twenty-four: / all those beginning with Nandā, in proper order, and likewise those beginning with Brahmāṇī;

18.s:
saṃvarto lakulīśaśca bhṛguḥ śveto bakastathā
khaṅgī pinākī bhujaṃgo navamo balireva ca
18.d:
संवर्तो लकुलीशश्च भृगुः श्वेतो बकस्तथा
खङ्गी पिनाकी भुजंगो नवमो बलिरेव च
18.m: Saṃvarta, Lakulīka, Bhṛgu, Śveta, Baka, / Khaḍgin, Pinākin, Bhujaga, and Bali as the ninth.

18.s:
mahākālo dviraṇḍaśca cchagalāṇḍaḥ śikhī tathā
lohito meṣamīnau ca tridaṇḍyoṣāḍhināmako
18.d:
महाकालो द्विरण्डश्च च्छगलाण्डः शिखी तथा
लोहितो मेषमीनौ च त्रिदण्ड्योषाढिनामको
18.m: Mahākāla, Dviraṇḍa, Chagalāṇḍa, Śikhin, / Lohita, Meṣa, Mīna, and those named Tridaṇḍin and Āṣāḍhin,

18.s:
umākānto'rdhanārīśo dāruko lāṅgalī tathā
tathā someśaśarmāṇau caturviṃśatyamī matāḥ
18.d:
उमाकान्तोऽर्धनारीशो दारुको लाङ्गली तथा
तथा सोमेशशर्माणौ चतुर्विंशत्यमी मताः
18.m: Umākānta, Ardhanārīśa, Dāruka, Lāṅgalin, / as well as Someśa and Śarman: these twenty-four are recognized.

18.s:
kādibhāntāḥ parijñeyā aṣṭora yādyamaṣṭakam
makāro bindurūpasthaḥ sarveṣāmupari sthitaḥ
18.d:
कादिभान्ताः परिज्ञेया अष्टोर याद्यमष्टकम्
मकारो बिन्दुरूपस्थः सर्वेषामुपरि स्थितः
18.m: Those beginning with ka and ending with bha are to be known [here]. In the eight-spoked [wheel] is the octad beginning with ya. / The phoneme ma, residing in the form of the drop, stands above all of them.

18.s:
juṃkāro'tha tathā svāhā ṣaḍare ṣaṭ krameṇa tu
baliśca balinandaśca daśagrīvo haro hayaḥ
18.d:
जुंकारोऽथ तथा स्वाहा षडरे षट् क्रमेण तु
बलिश्च बलिनन्दश्च दशग्रीवो हरो हयः
18.m: Then the syllable juṃ and likewise svāhā: in the six-spoked [wheel] there are six in sequence: / Bali, Balinanda, Daśagrīva, Hara, Haya,

18.s:
mādhavaśca mahādevi ṣaṣṭhaḥ saṃparikīrtitaḥ
viśvā viśveśvarī caiva hārādrī vīranāyikā
18.d:
माधवश्च महादेवि षष्ठः संपरिकीर्तितः
विश्वा विश्वेश्वरी चैव हाराद्री वीरनायिका
18.m: and Mādhava, O great goddess, is proclaimed as the sixth. / Viśvā, Viśveśvarī, Hārādrī, Vīranāyikā,

18.s:
ambā gurveti yoginyo bījaistaireva ṣaṭ smṛtāḥ
anyonyavalitāḥ sarve svāmyāvaraṇabhedataḥ
18.d:
अम्बा गुर्वेति योगिन्यो बीजैस्तैरेव षट् स्मृताः
अन्योन्यवलिताः सर्वे स्वाम्यावरणभेदतः
18.m: Ambā, and Gurvī: these six Yoginīs are taught with those very seed syllables. / They are all intertwined with one another through the distinction of lord and retinue.

18.s:
akarādikṣakārāntāḥ sarvasiddhiphalapradāḥ
dhyāṇārādhanayuktānāṃ yogināṃ mantriṇāmapi
18.d:
अकरादिक्षकारान्ताः सर्वसिद्धिफलप्रदाः
ध्याणाराधनयुक्तानां योगिनां मन्त्रिणामपि
18.m: Beginning with a and ending with kṣa, they bestow the fruits of all attainments / upon yogins and practitioners of mantras who are engaged in meditation and worship.

18.s:
athavā sarvacakrāṇāṃ madhye vidyāṃ yathepsitām
mantraṃ vā pūrvamuddiṣṭaṃ japandhyāyanprasiddhyati
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
iti śrīmālinīvijayottare tantre sarvamantranirṇayo nāma
viṃśatitamo'dhikāraḥ
18.d:
अथवा सर्वचक्राणां मध्ये विद्यां यथेप्सिताम्
मन्त्रं वा पूर्वमुद्दिष्टं जपन्ध्यायन्प्रसिद्ध्यति
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
इति श्रीमालिनीविजयोत्तरे तन्त्रे सर्वमन्त्रनिर्णयो नाम
विंशतितमोऽधिकारः
18.m:
Or, in the center of all the wheels, reciting and meditating on the vidyā / as desired, or on the mantra stated previously, one attains success.

Thus this has been taught in brief, bestowing the fruit of all desires.

Thus the twentieth chapter, entitled “Determination of All Mantras,” in the venerable Mālinīvijayottara, / is completed.

19.s:
athātaḥ paramaṃ guhyaṃ śivajñānāmṛtottamam
vyādhimṛtyuvināśāya yogināmupavarṇyate
19.d:
अथातः परमं गुह्यं शिवज्ञानामृतोत्तमम्
व्याधिमृत्युविनाशाय योगिनामुपवर्ण्यते
19.m: Now, the supreme secret, the highest nectar of Śiva's gnosis, / is described for yogins for the destruction of disease and death.

19.s:
ṣoḍaśāre khage cakre candrakalpitakarṇike
svarūpeṇa parāṃ tatra sravantīmamṛtaṃ smaret
19.d:
षोडशारे खगे चक्रे चन्द्रकल्पितकर्णिके
स्वरूपेण परां तत्र स्रवन्तीममृतं स्मरेत्
19.m: In the sixteen-spoked wheel moving through the void, whose pericarp is fashioned of the moon, / one should meditate on Parā flowing with nectar in her essential form.

19.s:
pūrvanyāsena saṃnaddhaḥ kṣaṇamekaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
tatastu rasanāṃ nītvā lambake viniyojayet
19.d:
पूर्वन्यासेन संनद्धः क्षणमेकं विचक्षणः
ततस्तु रसनां नीत्वा लम्बके विनियोजयेत्
19.m: Equipped with the preceding imposition for a single moment, the wise practitioner, / having then brought the tongue [upward], should join it to the uvula.

19.s:
sravantamamṛtaṃ divyaṃ candravimbasitaṃ smaret
mukhamāpūryate tasya kiṃcillavaṇavāriṇā
19.d:
स्रवन्तममृतं दिव्यं चन्द्रविम्बसितं स्मरेत्
मुखमापूर्यते तस्य किंचिल्लवणवारिणा
19.m: He should meditate on the divine nectar flowing, white as the lunar disc. / His mouth becomes somewhat filled with salty water

19.s:
lohagandhena taccātra na pivetkiṃtu nikṣipet
evaṃ samabhyasettāvadyāvattatsādu jāyate
19.d:
लोहगन्धेन तच्चात्र न पिवेत्किंतु निक्षिपेत्
एवं समभ्यसेत्तावद्यावत्तत्सादु जायते
19.m: having the smell of iron; and one should not swallow it here, but spit it out. / One should practice in this manner until it becomes sweet.

19.s:
jarāvyādhivinirmukto jāyate tatpibaṃstataḥ
ṣaḍbhirmāsairanāyāsādvatsarānmṛtyujidbhavet
19.d:
जराव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तो जायते तत्पिबंस्ततः
षड्भिर्मासैरनायासाद्वत्सरान्मृत्युजिद्भवेत्
19.m: Drinking that, he then becomes freed from old age and disease; / within six months he easily [becomes healthy], and after a year he becomes a conqueror of death.

19.s:
tatra sāduni saṃjāte tadāprabhṛti tatragam
yadeva cintayeddravyaṃ tenāsyāpūryate mukham
19.d:
तत्र सादुनि संजाते तदाप्रभृति तत्रगम्
यदेव चिन्तयेद्द्रव्यं तेनास्यापूर्यते मुखम्
19.m: When sweetness has arisen there, whatever substance moving there / he contemplates from that time on, with that his mouth becomes filled:

19.s:
rudhiraṃ madirāṃ vātha vasāṃ vā kṣīrameva vā
ghṛtatailādikaṃ vātha dravadravyamananyadhīḥ
19.d:
रुधिरं मदिरां वाथ वसां वा क्षीरमेव वा
घृततैलादिकं वाथ द्रवद्रव्यमनन्यधीः
19.m: blood, or wine, or fat, or milk, / or ghee, oil, and so forth—any liquid substance, with one-pointed mind.

19.s:
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi saṃkrāntividhimuttamam
mṛte jīvaccharīre tu praviśedyogavidyayā
19.d:
अथान्यं संप्रवक्ष्यामि संक्रान्तिविधिमुत्तमम्
मृते जीवच्छरीरे तु प्रविशेद्योगविद्यया
19.m: Now I shall declare another, the supreme rite of transference: / by means of yogic vidyā, one may enter into a dead body or a living one.

19.s:
nivātastho jitaprāṇo jitāsanavidhikramaḥ
kurvīta vāyunāveśamarkatūle śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
19.d:
निवातस्थो जितप्राणो जितासनविधिक्रमः
कुर्वीत वायुनावेशमर्कतूले शनैः शनैः
19.m: Dwelling in a place sheltered from wind, with breath mastered, having mastered the sequence of posture rites, / one should gradually effect penetration by means of the vital breath into the down of the arka plant,

19.s:
svādākṛṃṣṭividhiṃ yāvadguḍe nimbe ca kārayet
śrīkhaṇḍaguḍakarpūraistataḥ kṛtvākṛtiṃ śubhām
19.d:
स्वादाकृंष्टिविधिं यावद्गुडे निम्बे च कारयेत्
श्रीखण्डगुडकर्पूरैस्ततः कृत्वाकृतिं शुभाम्
19.m: until the rite of drawing out flavor is performed in molasses and neem. / Then, having fashioned a beautiful figure out of sandalwood, molasses, and camphor,

19.s:
praguṇāmaguṇa.............nyaṅgeṣu saṃdadhat
nyāsaṃ kṛtvāpi tatrāpi vedhaṃ kuryācchanaiḥ śanaiḥ
19.d:
प्रगुणामगुण॥॥॥॥॥॥।न्यङ्गेषु संदधत्
न्यासं कृत्वापि तत्रापि वेधं कुर्याच्छनैः शनैः
19.m: fixing it straight […] upon the limbs, / having performed imposition even there, one should gradually execute piercing there.

19.s:
nirodhaṃ tatra kurvīta ghaṭṭanaṃ tadanantaram
ghaṭṭanaṃ nāma vijñeyamaṅgapratyaṅgacālanam
19.d:
निरोधं तत्र कुर्वीत घट्टनं तदनन्तरम्
घट्टनं नाम विज्ञेयमङ्गप्रत्यङ्गचालनम्
19.m: There one should perform retention, and immediately after that, striking. / 'Striking' is to be understood as the moving of limbs and minor limbs.

19.s:
evamabhyasatastasya yogayuktasya yoginaḥ
calate pratimā sā tu dhāvate cāpi saṃmukhī
19.d:
एवमभ्यसतस्तस्य योगयुक्तस्य योगिनः
चलते प्रतिमा सा तु धावते चापि संमुखी
19.m: As that yogin engaged in yoga practices thus, / that effigy moves, and even runs facing him.

19.s:
punastāṃ prerayettāvadyāvatsvasthānamāgatām
patitāṃ cālayedbhūya uttānāṃ pārśvataḥ sthitām
19.d:
पुनस्तां प्रेरयेत्तावद्यावत्स्वस्थानमागताम्
पतितां चालयेद्भूय उत्तानां पार्श्वतः स्थिताम्
19.m: He should urge it on again until it comes back to its own place. / When it has fallen or lies supine, he, standing by its side, should move it again.

19.s:
evaṃ sarvātmanastāvadyāvatsvavaśatāṃ gatām
tataḥ prabhṛtyasau yogī praviśedyatra rocate
19.d:
एवं सर्वात्मनस्तावद्यावत्स्ववशतां गताम्
ततः प्रभृत्यसौ योगी प्रविशेद्यत्र रोचते
19.m: Thus [one proceeds] by all means until it comes under one's control. / From then on, that yogin may enter wherever he pleases,

19.s:
mṛte jīvaccharīre vā saṃkrāntyākrāntibhedataḥ
prakṣipya jalavacchaktijālaṃ sarvāṅgasaṃdhiṣu
19.d:
मृते जीवच्छरीरे वा संक्रान्त्याक्रान्तिभेदतः
प्रक्षिप्य जलवच्छक्तिजालं सर्वाङ्गसंधिषु
19.m: into a dead body or a living one, through the distinction of transference and taking possession. / Having cast the net of power like water into the joints of all the limbs,

19.s:
pratyaṅgamaṅgatastasya śaktiṃ tenākramedbudhaḥ
svakīyaṃ rakṣayeddehamākrāntāvanyathā tyajet
19.d:
प्रत्यङ्गमङ्गतस्तस्य शक्तिं तेनाक्रमेद्बुधः
स्वकीयं रक्षयेद्देहमाक्रान्तावन्यथा त्यजेत्
19.m: limb by limb and part by part, the wise practitioner should overpower its power with that. / In taking possession [of another body], he should guard his own body; otherwise, he should abandon it.

19.s:
bahūnyapi śarīrāṇi dṛḍhalakṣyo yadā bhavet
tadā gṛhṇātyasaṃdehaṃ yugapatsaṃtyajannapi
19.d:
बहून्यपि शरीराणि दृढलक्ष्यो यदा भवेत्
तदा गृह्णात्यसंदेहं युगपत्संत्यजन्नपि
19.m: When he has his aim firmly established, / he undoubtedly grasps even many bodies simultaneously, even while abandoning [them].

19.s:
athāparaṃ pravakṣyāmi sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam
samādhānāmṛtaṃ divyaṃ yogināṃ mṛtyunāśanam
19.d:
अथापरं प्रवक्ष्यामि सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकम्
समाधानामृतं दिव्यं योगिनां मृत्युनाशनम्
19.m: Now I shall teach another [rite] that produces immediate conviction, / the divine nectar of absorption, which destroys death for yogins,

19.s:
candrākṛṣṭikaraṃ nāma māsādvā yogabhogadam
śuklapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ meṣasthe tigmarociṣi
19.d:
चन्द्राकृष्टिकरं नाम मासाद्वा योगभोगदम्
शुक्लपक्षे द्वितीयायां मेषस्थे तिग्मरोचिषि
19.m: called 'Extraction of the Moon,' which bestows the enjoyment of yoga within a month. / On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight, when the sun is in Aries,

19.s:
snātaḥ śucirnirāhāraḥ kṛtapūjāvidhirbudhaḥ
nyaseccandre kalājālaṃ parayā samadhiṣṭhitam
19.d:
स्नातः शुचिर्निराहारः कृतपूजाविधिर्बुधः
न्यसेच्चन्द्रे कलाजालं परया समधिष्ठितम्
19.m: bathed, pure, fasting, having performed the ritual of worship, the wise practitioner / should impose upon the moon the net of kalās presided over by Parā.

19.s:
sarvabādhāparityakte pradeśe saṃsthito budhaḥ
ekacittaḥ praśāntātmā śivasadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
19.d:
सर्वबाधापरित्यक्ते प्रदेशे संस्थितो बुधः
एकचित्तः प्रशान्तात्मा शिवसद्भावभावितः
19.m: Dwelling in a place free from all disturbances, the wise practitioner, / single-minded, with a calmed self, cultivated with the true nature of Śiva,

19.s:
tāvadālokayeccandraṃ yāvadastamupāgataḥ
tato bhuñjīta dugdhena candradhyānasamanvitaḥ
19.d:
तावदालोकयेच्चन्द्रं यावदस्तमुपागतः
ततो भुञ्जीत दुग्धेन चन्द्रध्यानसमन्वितः
19.m: should gaze at the moon until it has set. / Then, accompanied by meditation on the moon, he should eat with milk.

19.s:
evaṃ dine dine kuryādyāvatpañcadaśī bhavet
śeṣāṃ rātriṃ svapeddhyāyam̐ścandrabimbagatāṃ parām
19.d:
एवं दिने दिने कुर्याद्यावत्पञ्चदशी भवेत्
शेषां रात्रिं स्वपेद्ध्यायम्̐श्चन्द्रबिम्बगतां पराम्
19.m: He should do this day after day until the fifteenth day comes. / Meditating on Parā residing within the lunar disc, he should sleep for the remainder of the night.

19.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā yogī ardharātra upasthitaḥ
jane niḥśabdatāṃ yāte prasupte sarvajantubhiḥ
19.d:
पौर्णमास्यां तथा योगी अर्धरात्र उपस्थितः
जने निःशब्दतां याते प्रसुप्ते सर्वजन्तुभिः
19.m: When the full moon has arrived, at midnight, / when people have become silent and all living beings are asleep,

19.s:
candrakoṭikaraprakhyāṃ tārahāravibhūṣaṇām
sitāmbaraparīdhānāṃ sitacandanacarcitām
19.d:
चन्द्रकोटिकरप्रख्यां तारहारविभूषणाम्
सिताम्बरपरीधानां सितचन्दनचर्चिताम्
19.m: resembling the rays of ten million moons, adorned with a necklace of stars, / clad in white garments, smeared with white sandalwood,

19.s:
mauktikābharaṇopetāṃ surūpāṃ navayauvanām
āpyāyanakarīṃ devīṃ samantādamṛtasravām
19.d:
मौक्तिकाभरणोपेतां सुरूपां नवयौवनाम्
आप्यायनकरीं देवीं समन्तादमृतस्रवाम्
19.m: endowed with pearl ornaments, beautiful in form, of youthful age, / the goddess who brings replenishment, pouring nectar all around,

19.s:
rājīvāsanasaṃsthāṃ ca yoganidrāmavasthitām
candrabimbe parāṃ devīmīkṣate nātra saṃśayaḥ
19.d:
राजीवासनसंस्थां च योगनिद्रामवस्थिताम्
चन्द्रबिम्बे परां देवीमीक्षते नात्र संशयः
19.m: seated on a lotus seat and dwelling in yogic sleep, / the supreme goddess he sees within the lunar disc: of this there is no doubt.

19.s:
tatastāṃ cetasā vyāpya tāvadākarṣayetsudhīḥ
yāvanmukhāgramāyātā tatra kuryātsthiraṃ manaḥ
19.d:
ततस्तां चेतसा व्याप्य तावदाकर्षयेत्सुधीः
यावन्मुखाग्रमायाता तत्र कुर्यात्स्थिरं मनः
19.m: Then, having pervaded her with the mind, the wise practitioner should draw her / until she arrives in front of his face; there he should make his mind steady.

19.s:
tataḥ prasārya vadanaṃ dhyānāsaktena cetasā
nigirettāṃ samākṛṣya bhūyo hṛdi vicintayet
19.d:
ततः प्रसार्य वदनं ध्यानासक्तेन चेतसा
निगिरेत्तां समाकृष्य भूयो हृदि विचिन्तयेत्
19.m: Then, opening his mouth, with a mind intent on meditation, / having drawn her in, he should swallow her, and again contemplate her in the heart.

19.s:
tayā praviṣṭayā dehaṃ yogī duḥkhavivarjitaḥ
śaktitulyabalo bhūtvā jīvedācandratārakam
19.d:
तया प्रविष्टया देहं योगी दुःखविवर्जितः
शक्तितुल्यबलो भूत्वा जीवेदाचन्द्रतारकम्
19.m: With her having entered his body, the yogin, freed from suffering / and having power equal to Śakti, shall live as long as the moon and stars.

19.s:
eko'pyanekadhātmānaṃ saṃvibhajya nijecchayā
trailokyaṃ yaugapadyena bhunakti vaśatāṃ gatam
19.d:
एकोऽप्यनेकधात्मानं संविभज्य निजेच्छया
त्रैलोक्यं यौगपद्येन भुनक्ति वशतां गतम्
19.m: Though being one, dividing himself manifoldly according to his own will, / he simultaneously enjoys the three worlds brought under his control.

19.s:
āsādya vipulānbhogānpralaye samupasthite
paramabhyeti nirvāṇaṃ duṣprāpamakṛtātmanām
19.d:
आसाद्य विपुलान्भोगान्प्रलये समुपस्थिते
परमभ्येति निर्वाणं दुष्प्रापमकृतात्मनाम्
19.m: Having attained immense enjoyments, when dissolution approaches, / he goes to supreme nirvāṇa, difficult to attain for those whose selves are uncultivated.

19.s:
athavā tanna śaknoti gagane paricintitum
pratibimbe tathā dhyāyedudakādiṣu pūrvavat
19.d:
अथवा तन्न शक्नोति गगने परिचिन्तितुम्
प्रतिबिम्बे तथा ध्यायेदुदकादिषु पूर्ववत्
19.m: Or, if he is unable to meditate on that in the sky, / he should likewise meditate on the reflection in water or the like, as before.

19.s:
tatpītvā manasā śeṣāṃ svapedrātrimanusmaran
pūrvoktaṃ samavāpnoti ṣaḍbhirmāsairakhaṇḍitam
19.d:
तत्पीत्वा मनसा शेषां स्वपेद्रात्रिमनुस्मरन्
पूर्वोक्तं समवाप्नोति षड्भिर्मासैरखण्डितम्
19.m: Having drunk that with the mind, he should sleep for the remainder of the night recollecting [it]; / in six months he obtains completely what was described previously.

20.s:
atha
dvāviṃśatitamo'dhikāraḥ
athānyatparamaṃ guhyaṃ kathayāmi tava priye
yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ yogāmṛtamanuttamam
20.d:
अथ
द्वाविंशतितमोऽधिकारः
अथान्यत्परमं गुह्यं कथयामि तव प्रिये
यन्न कस्यचिदाख्यातं योगामृतमनुत्तमम्
20.m: Now I shall tell you another supreme secret, O beloved, / the unexcelled nectar of yoga, which has not been spoken to anyone,

20.s:
sūryākṛṣṭikaraṃ nāma yogināṃ yogasiddhidam
samyagbhyāsacatuṣkeṇa dināṣṭabhyadhikena tu
20.d:
सूर्याकृष्टिकरं नाम योगिनां योगसिद्धिदम्
सम्यग्भ्यासचतुष्केण दिनाष्टभ्यधिकेन तु
20.m: called 'Extraction of the Sun,' which grants yogic attainment to yogins / in exactly four months and eight days.

20.s:
praharasyāṣṭamo bhāgo nāḍiketyabhidhīyate
tatpādakramavṛddhyā tu prativāsaramabhyaset
20.d:
प्रहरस्याष्टमो भागो नाडिकेत्यभिधीयते
तत्पादक्रमवृद्ध्या तु प्रतिवासरमभ्यसेत्
20.m: An eighth part of a prahara is designated a nāḍikā; / by a gradual increase of a quarter of that, one should practice every day.

20.s:
udyāstamayaṃ yāvadyatra sūryaḥ pradṛśyate
pradeśe tatra vijane sarvabādhāvivarjite
20.d:
उद्यास्तमयं यावद्यत्र सूर्यः प्रदृश्यते
प्रदेशे तत्र विजने सर्वबाधाविवर्जिते
20.m: In a secluded place, free from all impediments, / where the sun is visible from sunrise to sunset,

20.s:
ahorātroṣito yogī makarasthe divākare
śucirbhūtvā kṛtanyāsaḥ kṛtaśītapratikriyaḥ
20.d:
अहोरात्रोषितो योगी मकरस्थे दिवाकरे
शुचिर्भूत्वा कृतन्यासः कृतशीतप्रतिक्रियः
20.m: having fasted for a day and night when the sun is in Capricorn, / the yogī, purified, having performed the imposition, and having taken precautions against the cold,

20.s:
bhānubimbe nyaseccakramaṣṭaṣaṭdvādaśārakam
trivaśaktighanopetaṃ bhairavāṣṭakasaṃyutam
20.d:
भानुबिम्बे न्यसेच्चक्रमष्टषट्द्वादशारकम्
त्रिवशक्तिघनोपेतं भैरवाष्टकसंयुतम्
20.m: should project upon the solar disc a wheel of eight, six, and twelve spokes, / filled with the dense mass of Śiva and Śakti, accompanied by the eight Bhairavas,

20.s:
varṣādikṛtusaṃyuktaṃ māsairṛkṣādibhiryutam
aṣṭāraṃ cintayedvimbe śeṣaṃ raśmiṣu cintayet
20.d:
वर्षादिकृतुसंयुक्तं मासैरृक्षादिभिर्युतम्
अष्टारं चिन्तयेद्विम्बे शेषं रश्मिषु चिन्तयेत्
20.m: endowed with the year and other seasons, accompanied by the months and asterisms; / he should contemplate the eight-spoked [wheel] in the disc and the rest in the rays.

20.s:
tatra cittaṃ samādhāya proktakālaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
tataḥ kāle vyatikrānte sunimīlitalocanaḥ
praviśeddhandhakārāntarbhuvanaṃ nirupadravam
20.d:
तत्र चित्तं समाधाय प्रोक्तकालं विचक्षणः
ततः काले व्यतिक्रान्ते सुनिमीलितलोचनः
प्रविशेद्धन्धकारान्तर्भुवनं निरुपद्रवम्
20.m:
Concentrating his mind there, the wise practitioner / should gaze at the solar disc with unblinking eyes for the prescribed time.

Then, once the time has passed, with his eyes well closed, / he should enter a undisturbed dwelling within the darkness.

20.s:
tatronmīlitanetrastu bimbākāraṃ prapaśyati
saṃdhāya tatra caitanyaṃ tiṣṭhedyāvanna paśyati
20.d:
तत्रोन्मीलितनेत्रस्तु बिम्बाकारं प्रपश्यति
संधाय तत्र चैतन्यं तिष्ठेद्यावन्न पश्यति
20.m: Opening his eyes there, he sees the form of the disc. / Uniting his consciousness there, he should remain as long as he sees [it].

20.s:
naṣṭe'pi cetasā śeṣaṃ tiṣṭhetkālamanusmaran
evaṃ māsena deveśi sthiraṃ tadupajāyate
20.d:
नष्टेऽपि चेतसा शेषं तिष्ठेत्कालमनुस्मरन्
एवं मासेन देवेशि स्थिरं तदुपजायते
20.m: Even when it has vanished, he should remain mentally recalling it for the rest of the time. / In this way, O goddess of the gods, it becomes stable in one month.

20.s:
māsadvayena sarvatra prekṣate nātra saṃśayaḥ
tribhiḥ samīkṣate sarvaṃ ravivimbasamākulam
20.d:
मासद्वयेन सर्वत्र प्रेक्षते नात्र संशयः
त्रिभिः समीक्षते सर्वं रविविम्बसमाकुलम्
20.m: In two months he sees it everywhere; of this there is no doubt. / In three months he perceives everything pervaded by the solar disc.

20.s:
prektakālāvasānena tṛpasthe tigmarociṣi
prekṣate sūryabimbāntaḥ sacakraṃ parameśvaram
20.d:
प्रेक्तकालावसानेन तृपस्थे तिग्मरोचिषि
प्रेक्षते सूर्यबिम्बान्तः सचक्रं परमेश्वरम्
20.m: At the end of the prescribed time, when the sun is in Taurus, / he sees the Supreme Lord with the wheel inside the solar disc.

20.s:
upalabdhaṃ samākṛṣya mukhāgre sthiratāṃ nayet
āpauya pūrvavatpaścādṛttiṃ niścalatāṃ nayet
20.d:
उपलब्धं समाकृष्य मुखाग्रे स्थिरतां नयेत्
आपौय पूर्ववत्पश्चादृत्तिं निश्चलतां नयेत्
20.m: Drawing in what has been perceived, he should bring it to stability before his face; / having drunk it in as before, he should afterwards bring the mental fluctuation to stillness.

20.s:
tatra tena sahātmānamekīkṛtya muhūrtakam
yāvattiṣṭhati deveśi tāvatsaṃtyajati kṣitim
20.d:
तत्र तेन सहात्मानमेकीकृत्य मुहूर्तकम्
यावत्तिष्ठति देवेशि तावत्संत्यजति क्षितिम्
20.m: Having unified himself with it there for a muhūrta, / as long as he remains, O goddess of the gods, so long does he leave the earth.

20.s:
paśyato janavṛndasya yāti sūryeṇa caikataḥ
anena vidhinā devi siddhayogīśvareśvaraḥ
20.d:
पश्यतो जनवृन्दस्य याति सूर्येण चैकतः
अनेन विधिना देवि सिद्धयोगीश्वरेश्वरः
20.m: While the crowd of people watches, he departs in union with the sun. / By this rite, O goddess, he becomes a lord of masters among realized yogīs.

20.s:
śivādyavaniparyantaṃ na kvacitpratihanyate
bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānniṣkalai līyate pare
20.d:
शिवाद्यवनिपर्यन्तं न क्वचित्प्रतिहन्यते
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान्भोगान्निष्कलै लीयते परे
20.m: From Śiva down to the earth, he is nowhere obstructed. / And having enjoyed abundant pleasures, he is dissolved into the supreme partless [state].

20.s:
tadetat khecarīcakraṃ yatra khecaratāṃ vrajet
siddhayogīśvarītantre sarahasyamudāhṛtam
20.d:
तदेतत् खेचरीचक्रं यत्र खेचरतां व्रजेत्
सिद्धयोगीश्वरीतन्त्रे सरहस्यमुदाहृतम्
20.m: This is that Khecarī wheel wherein he attains motion in the void; / it was declared together with its secret in the Siddhayogeśvarītantra.

20.s:
athavā cakrarūpeṇa sabāhyābhyantaraṃ svakam
dehaṃ cintayataḥ pūrvaṃ phalaṃ syānniścitātmanaḥ
20.d:
अथवा चक्ररूपेण सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं स्वकम्
देहं चिन्तयतः पूर्वं फलं स्यान्निश्चितात्मनः
20.m: Alternatively, for one of resolute mind who contemplates his own body, / outer and inner, in the form of the wheel, the earlier result will occur.

20.s:
uccaranphādināntāṃ vā dhvanijyortimarudyutām
viśrāmya mastake cittaṃ kṣaṇamekaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
20.d:
उच्चरन्फादिनान्तां वा ध्वनिज्योर्तिमरुद्युताम्
विश्राम्य मस्तके चित्तं क्षणमेकं विचक्षणः
20.m: Or else, reciting [the mantra] beginning with PHA and ending with NA, possessing the radiance of sound, light, and wind, / the wise practitioner, resting the mind in the crown of the head for a single moment,

20.s:
triśūlena prayogena sadyastyajati medinīm
evaṃ samabhyasanmāsāccakravadbhramati kṣitau
20.d:
त्रिशूलेन प्रयोगेन सद्यस्त्यजति मेदिनीम्
एवं समभ्यसन्मासाच्चक्रवद्भ्रमति क्षितौ
20.m: immediately leaves the earth by the practice with the trident. / Practicing thus for a month, he spins like a wheel on the ground.

20.s:
muhūrtaṃ spṛśate bhūmiṃ muhūrtāca nabhastalam
śivāśavādi kurute valanāsphoṭanāni ca
20.d:
मुहूर्तं स्पृशते भूमिं मुहूर्ताच नभस्तलम्
शिवाशवादि कुरुते वलनास्फोटनानि च
20.m: For a muhūrta he touches the earth, and after a muhūrta [he touches] the sky; / he emits jackal howls and other sounds, and performs twisting and clapping,

20.s:
mudrābandhādikaṃ vātha bhāṣā vā vattyanekadhā
ṣaṇmāsānmedinīṃ tyaktvā samādhistho dṛḍhendriyaḥ
20.d:
मुद्राबन्धादिकं वाथ भाषा वा वत्त्यनेकधा
षण्मासान्मेदिनीं त्यक्त्वा समाधिस्थो दृढेन्द्रियः
20.m: or binding of mudrās and the like, and utters varied kinds of speech. / Having left the earth for six months, absorbed in samādhi, his senses firm,

20.s:
tiṣṭhate hastamātreṇa gagane yogacintakaḥ
paśyate yoginīvṛndamanekākāralakṣaṇam
20.d:
तिष्ठते हस्तमात्रेण गगने योगचिन्तकः
पश्यते योगिनीवृन्दमनेकाकारलक्षणम्
20.m: the contemplator of yoga stays suspended by a single cubit in the sky. / He sees the host of yoginīs of manifold forms and characteristics.

20.s:
saṃvatsareṇa yuktātmā tatsamānaḥ prajāyate
paśyatāmeva lokānāṃ tejobhirbhāsayandiśaḥ
20.d:
संवत्सरेण युक्तात्मा तत्समानः प्रजायते
पश्यतामेव लोकानां तेजोभिर्भासयन्दिशः
20.m: In a year, his self unified, he becomes their equal. / While ordinary people look on, illuminating the directions with rays of light,

20.s:
yātyutkṛṣya mahīpṛṣṭhāt khecarīṇāṃ patirbhavet
mudrā khageśvarī nāma kathitā yoginīmate
20.d:
यात्युत्कृष्य महीपृष्ठात् खेचरीणां पतिर्भवेत्
मुद्रा खगेश्वरी नाम कथिता योगिनीमते
20.m: he departs, rising up from the surface of the earth, and becomes a lord of the sky-faring [yoginīs]. / In the doctrine of the Yoginīs, this mudrā is called Khageśvarī.

20.s:
jāgaritvātha vā yogī tryahorātramatandritaḥ
caturthe'hni niśārambhe pūjayitvā maheśvaram
20.d:
जागरित्वाथ वा योगी त्र्यहोरात्रमतन्द्रितः
चतुर्थेऽह्नि निशारम्भे पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम्
20.m: Or else, the yogī, having stayed awake without indolence for three days and nights, / having worshipped the Great Lord at the start of night on the fourth day,

20.s:
tato'ndhakāre bahule kṛtarakṣāvidhirbudhaḥ
dhruvormadhye samādhāya kṣaṇaṃ cetaḥ prapaśyati
20.d:
ततोऽन्धकारे बहुले कृतरक्षाविधिर्बुधः
ध्रुवोर्मध्ये समाधाय क्षणं चेतः प्रपश्यति
20.m: and having performed the protective rite, the wise practitioner, in dense darkness, / focusing his mind between the eyebrows for a moment, perceives

20.s:
tejo rūpapratīkāśaṃ paryaṅkāsanamāsthitaḥ
prayogaṃ tveva satataṃ yogayuktaḥ samabhyaset
20.d:
तेजो रूपप्रतीकाशं पर्यङ्कासनमास्थितः
प्रयोगं त्वेव सततं योगयुक्तः समभ्यसेत्
20.m: a brilliance resembling a bodily form, while seated in the paryaṅka posture. / Engaged in yoga, he should continuously practice this method.

20.s:
paśyate māsamātreṇa gṛhāntarvastu yat sthitam
dvābhyāṃ bahiḥ sthitaṃ sarvaṃ tribhiḥ pattanasaṃsthitam
20.d:
पश्यते मासमात्रेण गृहान्तर्वस्तु यत् स्थितम्
द्वाभ्यां बहिः स्थितं सर्वं त्रिभिः पत्तनसंस्थितम्
20.m: In only a month he sees whatever object is located inside a house; / in two, everything situated outside; in three, what is in the city;

20.s:
caturbhirviṣayāntaḥsthaṃ pañcabhirmaṇḍalāvadhi
ṣadbhirmāsairmahāyogī cchidrāṃ paśyati medinīm
20.d:
चतुर्भिर्विषयान्तःस्थं पञ्चभिर्मण्डलावधि
षद्भिर्मासैर्महायोगी च्छिद्रां पश्यति मेदिनीम्
20.m: in four, what is within the district; in five, up to the limits of the realm. / In six months, the great yogī sees through the earth [as if it were] porous.

20.s:
sarvajñatvamavāpnoti vatsarātrātra saṃśayaḥ
yoginīsiddhasaṃghasya sadbhāvavyāptisaṃsthitam
20.d:
सर्वज्ञत्वमवाप्नोति वत्सरात्रात्र संशयः
योगिनीसिद्धसंघस्य सद्भावव्याप्तिसंस्थितम्
20.m: In a year he attains omniscience; of this there is no doubt. / He who is united with yoga sees that which resides in the pervasion of reality

20.s:
paśyate yogayuktātmā tatsamānaśca jāyate
anenaiva vidhānena svastikāsanasaṃsthitaḥ
20.d:
पश्यते योगयुक्तात्मा तत्समानश्च जायते
अनेनैव विधानेन स्वस्तिकासनसंस्थितः
20.m: of the assembly of yoginīs and siddhas, and he becomes their equal. / By this very procedure, seated in the svastika posture,

20.s:
binduṃ nānāvidhaṃ tyaktvā śuddharūpamanusmaret
tenāpi sarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ vyāpnoti phalamuttamam
20.d:
बिन्दुं नानाविधं त्यक्त्वा शुद्धरूपमनुस्मरेत्
तेनापि सर्वं पूर्वोक्तं व्याप्नोति फलमुत्तमम्
20.m: leaving aside the varied points, he should contemplate the pure form. / Through that as well he attains all the highest fruit mentioned before.

21.s:
atha
trayoviṃśatitamo'dhikāraḥ
athātaḥ paramaṃ guhyaṃ kathayāmi tavādhunā
sadyopalabdhijanakaṃ yogināṃ yogasiddhaye
21.d:
अथ
त्रयोविंशतितमोऽधिकारः
अथातः परमं गुह्यं कथयामि तवाधुना
सद्योपलब्धिजनकं योगिनां योगसिद्धये
21.m:
Twenty-third chapter.

Now I will explain to you the supreme secret, / which brings immediate realization to yogīs for yogic attainment.

21.s:
pūrvanyāsena saṃnaddhaścittaṃ śrotre niveśayet
nivāte svalpavāte vā bāhyaśabdavivarjite
21.d:
पूर्वन्यासेन संनद्धश्चित्तं श्रोत्रे निवेशयेत्
निवाते स्वल्पवाते वा बाह्यशब्दविवर्जिते
21.m: Equipped with the previous imposition, he should place his mind in the ear, / in a place free from wind or with little wind, and devoid of external sound.

21.s:
tatastatra śṛṇotyeṣa yogī dhvanimanārhatam
suviśuddhasya kāṃsyasya hatasyeha muhurmuhuḥ
21.d:
ततस्तत्र शृणोत्येष योगी ध्वनिमनार्हतम्
सुविशुद्धस्य कांस्यस्य हतस्येह मुहुर्मुहुः
21.m: Then the yogī hears there an uninhibited sound, / like that of very pure bronze struck repeatedly here,

21.s:
yamākarṇya mahādevi puṇyapāpaiḥ pramucyate
tatra saṃdhāya caitanyaṃ ṣaṇmāsādyogavittamaḥ
21.d:
यमाकर्ण्य महादेवि पुण्यपापैः प्रमुच्यते
तत्र संधाय चैतन्यं षण्मासाद्योगवित्तमः
21.m: hearing which, O great goddess, he is freed from merit and demerit. / Concentrating his consciousness there, in six months the best of knowers of yoga

21.s:
rutaṃ pakṣmigaṇasyāpi prasphuṭaṃ vettyayatnataḥ
dūrācchravaṇavijñānaṃ vatsareṇāsya jāyate
21.d:
रुतं पक्ष्मिगणस्यापि प्रस्फुटं वेत्त्ययत्नतः
दूराच्छ्रवणविज्ञानं वत्सरेणास्य जायते
21.m: clearly comprehends effortlessly even the cries of a flock of birds. / In a year, knowledge from distant hearing arises for him.

21.s:
sarvakāmaphalāvāptirvatsaratritayena ca
siddhyatīti kimāścaryamanāyāsena siddhyati
21.d:
सर्वकामफलावाप्तिर्वत्सरत्रितयेन च
सिद्ध्यतीति किमाश्चर्यमनायासेन सिद्ध्यति
21.m: And in three years the attainment of the fruits of all desires / succeeds. What wonder that it succeeds without effort!

21.s:
athavā grahaṇe māsi kṛtvā sūryyaṃ tu pṛṣṭhataḥ
pūrvanyāsena saṃnaddhaḥ kiṃcidbhittimadāśritaḥ
21.d:
अथवा ग्रहणे मासि कृत्वा सूर्य्यं तु पृष्ठतः
पूर्वन्यासेन संनद्धः किंचिद्भित्तिमदाश्रितः
21.m: Or else, having placed the sun at his back in the month of an eclipse, / equipped with the previous imposition, resting against a wall,

21.s:
lakṣayedātmanaśchāyāṃ mastakordhvamanāhatām
dhūmavartiviniṣkrāntāṃ tadgatenāntarātmanā
21.d:
लक्षयेदात्मनश्छायां मस्तकोर्ध्वमनाहताम्
धूमवर्तिविनिष्क्रान्तां तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना
21.m: with his inner self directed toward it, he should observe his own shadow / rising without impact above his head, issuing forth like a column of smoke.

21.s:
yāti tanmayatāṃ tatra yogayukto yathā yathā
tathā tathāsya mahatī sā vittirūpajāyate
21.d:
याति तन्मयतां तत्र योगयुक्तो यथा यथा
तथा तथास्य महती सा वित्तिरूपजायते
21.m: In proportion as the one engaged in yoga merges into identity with it there, / in that proportion does great awareness arise for him.

21.s:
tatastatra mahātejaḥ sphuratkiraṇasaṃnibham
paśyate yatra dṛṣṭe'pi sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet
21.d:
ततस्तत्र महातेजः स्फुरत्किरणसंनिभम्
पश्यते यत्र दृष्टेऽपि सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत्
21.m: Then he sees a great brilliance there, resembling flashing rays, / upon the sight of which all sins are destroyed.

21.s:
tadasyābhyasato māsātsarvatra pravisarpati
jvālāmālākulākārā diśaḥ sarvāḥ prapaśyati
21.d:
तदस्याभ्यसतो मासात्सर्वत्र प्रविसर्पति
ज्वालामालाकुलाकारा दिशः सर्वाः प्रपश्यति
21.m: Through practicing this for a month, it diffuses everywhere for him; / he sees all the directions filled with wreaths of flame.

21.s:
ṣaṇmāsamabhyasanyogī sarvajñatvamavāpnuyāt
abdaṃ divyatanurbhūtvā śivavanmodate ciram
21.d:
षण्मासमभ्यसन्योगी सर्वज्ञत्वमवाप्नुयात्
अब्दं दिव्यतनुर्भूत्वा शिववन्मोदते चिरम्
21.m: Practicing for six months, the yogī attains omniscience; / in a year, acquiring a divine body, he rejoices for a long time like Śiva.

21.s:
atha jātyaḥ pravakṣyante sapūrvāsanaśāśvatāḥ
hrīṃ kṣlāṃ kṣvīṃ vaṃ tathā kṣaṃ ca pañcakasya yathākramam
21.d:
अथ जात्यः प्रवक्ष्यन्ते सपूर्वासनशाश्वताः
ह्रीं क्ष्लां क्ष्वीं वं तथा क्षं च पञ्चकस्य यथाक्रमम्
21.m: Now the auxiliary suffixes along with the eternal basic seat will be taught: / HRĪṂ, KṢLĀṂ, KṢVĪṂ, VAṂ, and KṢAṂ, respectively, of the pentad;

21.s:
haṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ tathā vaṃ ca pañcakasyāparasya ca
ṛṃ ṝṃ lūṃ lūm̐ tathā oṃ auṃ haḥ aṃ ākarṇikāvadhau
21.d:
हं यं रं लं तथा वं च पञ्चकस्यापरस्य च
ऋं ॠं लूं लूम्̐ तथा ओं औं हः अं आकर्णिकावधौ
21.m: HAṂ, YAṂ, RAṂ, LAṂ, and VAṂ of the other pentad; / ṚṂ, ṜṂ, ḶṂ, ḸṂ, OṂ, AUṂ, HAḤ, AṂ up to the pericarp;

21.s:
kesareṣu bhakārāntā haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ ca huṃ tathā
hūṃ haiṃ haiṃ ca daleṣvevaṃ svasaṃjñābhiśca śaktayaḥ
21.d:
केसरेषु भकारान्ता हं हां हिं हीं च हुं तथा
हूं हैं हैं च दलेष्वेवं स्वसंज्ञाभिश्च शक्तयः
21.m: on the filaments, ending with BHA: HAṂ, HĀṂ, HIṂ, HĪṂ, HUṂ, / HŪṂ, HEṂ, and HAIṂ; and on the petals, the Śaktis with their respective names;

21.s:
maṇḍalatritaye śeṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ pretasya kalpayet
jakāraṃ śūlaśṛṅgāṇāmityetatparikīrtitam
anuktāsanayogeṣu sarvatraivaṃ prakalpayet
namaḥ svāhā tathā vaṣaḍ huṃ vauṣaṭ phaṭ ca jātayaḥ
21.d:
मण्डलत्रितये शेषं सूक्ष्मं प्रेतस्य कल्पयेत्
जकारं शूलशृङ्गाणामित्येतत्परिकीर्तितम्
अनुक्तासनयोगेषु सर्वत्रैवं प्रकल्पयेत्
नमः स्वाहा तथा वषड् हुं वौषट् फट् च जातयः
21.m:
in the triad of circles one should project the subtle remainder of the corpse; / the phoneme JRA on the prongs of the trident—thus it has been declared.

In all seat applications where they are unstated, one should universally project: / NAMAḤ, SVĀHĀ, VAUṢAṬ, HUṂ, VAṢAṬ, and PHAṬ as the auxiliary suffixes.

21.s:
prāyaścitteṣu sarveṣu japenmālāmakhaṇḍitām
bhinnāṃ vāpyathavābhinnāmatikramabalāvalām
21.d:
प्रायश्चित्तेषु सर्वेषु जपेन्मालामखण्डिताम्
भिन्नां वाप्यथवाभिन्नामतिक्रमबलावलाम्
21.m: In all rites of expiation, one should recite the garland [mantra] unbroken, / or divided or undivided, according to the relative weight of the transgression,

21.s:
sakṛjjapātsamārabhya yāvallakṣatrayaṃ priye
prāṇavṛttitirodhena tataḥ parataraṃ kvacit
21.d:
सकृज्जपात्समारभ्य यावल्लक्षत्रयं प्रिये
प्राणवृत्तितिरोधेन ततः परतरं क्वचित्
21.m: beginning from a single recitation up to three hundred thousand [times], O dear one, / by restraint of the movement of the breath, and somewhere beyond that.

21.s:
sadā bhramaṇaśīlānāṃ pīṭhakṣetrādikaṃ bahiḥ
prayogaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi sukhasiddhiphalapradam
21.d:
सदा भ्रमणशीलानां पीठक्षेत्रादिकं बहिः
प्रयोगं संप्रवक्ष्यामि सुखसिद्धिफलप्रदम्
21.m: For those whose nature is always to wander externally among holy seats, sacred fields, and the like, / I shall explain an application that bestows the fruit of easy attainment.

21.s:
nāsākrāntaṃ mahāprāṇaṃ daṇḍarūpaṃ sabindukam
tadvruddhaṃ ca kurvīta vidyeyaṃ dvyakṣarā matā
21.d:
नासाक्रान्तं महाप्राणं दण्डरूपं सबिन्दुकम्
तद्व्रुद्धं च कुर्वीत विद्येयं द्व्यक्षरा मता
21.m: One should make the great breath, reached at the nose, stick-shaped and with a bindu, / and likewise at the secret [region]; this vidyā is considered to consist of two syllables.

21.s:
asyāḥ pūrvoktavidhinā kṛtasevaḥ prasannadhīḥ
pīṭhādikaṃ bhrametsiddhayai nānyathā vīravandite
21.d:
अस्याः पूर्वोक्तविधिना कृतसेवः प्रसन्नधीः
पीठादिकं भ्रमेत्सिद्धयै नान्यथा वीरवन्दिते
21.m: Having performed its preparatory service according to the rule previously stated, with a serene mind, / one should wander through the holy seats and other sites for attainment, not otherwise, O one praised by heroes.

21.s:
tatpradeśaṃ samāsādya mantrairātmānamādarāt
vidyayā veṣṭayetsthānaṃ raktasūtrasamānayā
21.d:
तत्प्रदेशं समासाद्य मन्त्रैरात्मानमादरात्
विद्यया वेष्टयेत्स्थानं रक्तसूत्रसमानया
21.m: Having reached that place, one should carefully [protect] oneself with mantras, / and with the vidyā, which resembles a red thread, surround the place

21.s:
bahudhānanyacittastu sabāhyābhyantaraṃ budhaḥ
tatastatra kvacitkṣetre yoginyo bhīmavikramāḥ
21.d:
बहुधानन्यचित्तस्तु सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं बुधः
ततस्तत्र क्वचित्क्षेत्रे योगिन्यो भीमविक्रमाः
21.m: in many ways, single-minded, inside and outside, O wise one. / Then in that field somewhere, yoginīs of formidable valor,

21.s:
samāgatya prayacchanti saṃpradāyaṃ svakaṃ svakam
yenāsau labdhamātreṇa saṃpradāyena suvrate
21.d:
समागत्य प्रयच्छन्ति संप्रदायं स्वकं स्वकम्
येनासौ लब्धमात्रेण संप्रदायेन सुव्रते
21.m: having arrived, impart each their own lineage tradition. / As soon as he has obtained this lineage tradition, O woman of good vows,

21.s:
tatsamānabalo bhūtvā bhuṅkte bhogānyathepsitān
athavā kṛtasevastu lakṣamekaṃ japetsudhīḥ
21.d:
तत्समानबलो भूत्वा भुङ्क्ते भोगान्यथेप्सितान्
अथवा कृतसेवस्तु लक्षमेकं जपेत्सुधीः
21.m: having become of equal strength to them, he enjoys the pleasures he desires. / Alternatively, having performed the preparatory service, the wise one should recite [it] one hundred thousand times;

21.s:
tarpayitvā daśāṃśena kṣudrakarmasu yojayet
tatroccāritamātreyaṃ viṣakṣayakarī bhavet
21.d:
तर्पयित्वा दशांशेन क्षुद्रकर्मसु योजयेत्
तत्रोच्चारितमात्रेयं विषक्षयकरी भवेत्
21.m: having gratified [it] with a tenth part, he may employ it in minor operations. / There, as soon as it is pronounced, it causes the destruction of poison.

21.s:
cakravadbhramamāṇaiṣā yonau raktāṃ vicintayet
gamāgamakramādvāpi vinda............vāritā
21.d:
चक्रवद्भ्रममाणैषा योनौ रक्तां विचिन्तयेत्
गमागमक्रमाद्वापि विन्द॥॥॥॥॥॥वारिता
21.m: Whirling like a wheel, one should visualize this red [energy] in the yoni, / or by the sequence of going and coming, […]

21.s:
tatrasthaścāśu saṃghātavidhātākuñcanena tu
kṣaṇādananyacittastu kṣobhayedurvaśīmapi
21.d:
तत्रस्थश्चाशु संघातविधाताकुञ्चनेन तु
क्षणादनन्यचित्तस्तु क्षोभयेदुर्वशीमपि
21.m: And dwelling there, swiftly, by contraction and expansion through striking the mass, / with an undivided mind, in an instant he could agitate even Urvaśī.

21.s:
kṛtasevāvidhirvātha lakṣatrayajapena tu
mahatīṃ śriyamādhatte padmaśrīphalatarpitā
21.d:
कृतसेवाविधिर्वाथ लक्षत्रयजपेन तु
महतीं श्रियमाधत्ते पद्मश्रीफलतर्पिता
21.m: Or having completed the rules of preparatory service, by a recitation of three hundred thousand times, / being gratified with lotuses and bilva fruits, it bestows great prosperity.

21.s:
ṣaḍutyāsanasaṃsthānā sādhitāpyuktavartmanā
sarvasiddhikarī devī mantriṇāmupajāyate
21.d:
षडुत्यासनसंस्थाना साधिताप्युक्तवर्त्मना
सर्वसिद्धिकरी देवी मन्त्रिणामुपजायते
21.m: Established upon a seat arisen from the six, and accomplished by the path taught, / the goddess brings about all attainments for practitioners of mantras.

21.s:
śūlapadmavidhiṃ muktvā navāt‌mādyaṃ ca saptakam
ṣaḍutthamāsanaṃ dadyātsarvacakravidhau budhaḥ
21.d:
शूलपद्मविधिं मुक्त्वा नवात्‌माद्यं च सप्तकम्
षडुत्थमासनं दद्यात्सर्वचक्रविधौ बुधः
21.m: Omitting the rite of the trident-lotus and the seven beginning with Navātman, / the wise one should provide the sixfold seat in all rites of the cakra.

21.s:
mudrā ca mahatī yojyā hṛdbījenopacārakam
athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi svapnajñānamanuttamam
21.d:
मुद्रा च महती योज्या हृद्बीजेनोपचारकम्
अथान्यत्संप्रवक्ष्यामि स्वप्नज्ञानमनुत्तमम्
21.m: And the great mudrā is to be applied, an attendance with the heart-seed. / Now I will explain another [teaching], the unsurpassed dream cognition.

21.s:
hṛccakre tanmayo bhūtvā rātrau rātrāvananyadhīḥ
māsādūrdhvaṃ mahādevi svapne yatkiṃcidīkṣate
21.d:
हृच्चक्रे तन्मयो भूत्वा रात्रौ रात्रावनन्यधीः
मासादूर्ध्वं महादेवि स्वप्ने यत्किंचिदीक्षते
21.m: Having become absorbed in it at the heart-cakra night after night with undivided thought, / after a month, O great goddess, whatever he sees in a dream

21.s:
tattathyaṃ jāyate tasya dhyānayuktasya yoginaḥ
tatraiva yadi kālasya niyamena rato bhavet
21.d:
तत्तथ्यं जायते तस्य ध्यानयुक्तस्य योगिनः
तत्रैव यदि कालस्य नियमेन रतो भवेत्
21.m: comes true for that yogin engaged in meditation. / If right there he should be devoted to the restriction of time,

21.s:
tadā prathamayāme tu vatsareṇa śubhāśubham
ṣa‌ḍtrimāsena kramaśo dvitīyādiṣvanukramāt
21.d:
तदा प्रथमयामे तु वत्सरेण शुभाशुभम्
ष‌ड्त्रिमासेन क्रमशो द्वितीयादिष्वनुक्रमात्
21.m: then in the first watch [he sees the good and bad] in a year; / in six and three months respectively in the second and following [watches] in succession;

21.s:
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ daśāhena phalaṃ labhet
saṃkalpapūrvake'pyevaṃ pareṣāmātmano'pi vā
21.d:
अरुणोदयवेलायां दशाहेन फलं लभेत्
संकल्पपूर्वकेऽप्येवं परेषामात्मनोऽपि वा
21.m: at the time of dawn he will obtain the result in ten days. / Even when preceded by a specific intention, for others or for oneself,

21.s:
kvacitkārye samutpanne suptajñānamupākramet
ityetatkathitaṃ devi siddhayogīśvarīmatam
21.d:
क्वचित्कार्ये समुत्पन्ने सुप्तज्ञानमुपाक्रमेत्
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि सिद्धयोगीश्वरीमतम्
21.m: when any matter arises, one should undertake dream cognition. / Thus this has been declared, O goddess, the doctrine of the Siddhayogīśvarīs.

21.s:
nātaḥ parataraṃ jñānaṃ śivādyavanigocare
ya evaṃ tattvato veda sa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥ
21.d:
नातः परतरं ज्ञानं शिवाद्यवनिगोचरे
य एवं तत्त्वतो वेद स शिवो नात्र संशयः
21.m: There is no higher knowledge than this in the domain from Śiva down to the earth. / Whoever knows this in truth is Śiva, there is no doubt in this.

21.s:
tasya pādarajaḥ mūrdhni dhṛtaṃ pāpapraśāntaye
etacchrutvā mahādevī paraṃ santoṣamāgatā
21.d:
तस्य पादरजः मूर्ध्नि धृतं पापप्रशान्तये
एतच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवी परं सन्तोषमागता
21.m: The dust of his feet placed on one's head brings about the pacification of sins. / Having heard this, the Great Goddess attained supreme satisfaction;

21.s:
evaṃ kṣamāpayāmāsa praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ
iti vaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mālinīvijayottaram
21.d:
एवं क्षमापयामास प्रणिपत्य पुनः पुनः
इति वः सर्वमाख्यातं मालिनीविजयोत्तरम्
21.m: bowing again and again, she asked forgiveness in this manner. / Thus all has been told to you, the Mālinīvijayottara.

21.s:
mamaitatkathitaṃ devyā yogāmṛtamanuttamam
bhavadbhirapi nākhyeyamaśiṣyāṇāmidaṃ mahat
21.d:
ममैतत्कथितं देव्या योगामृतमनुत्तमम्
भवद्भिरपि नाख्येयमशिष्याणामिदं महत्
21.m: This unsurpassed nectar of yoga was declared to me by the goddess; / nor should this great [teaching] be told by you to non-disciples,

21.s:
na cāpi paraśiṣyāṇāmaparīkṣya prayatnataḥ
sarvathaitatsamākhyātaṃ yogābhyāsaratātmanām
21.d:
न चापि परशिष्याणामपरीक्ष्य प्रयत्नतः
सर्वथैतत्समाख्यातं योगाभ्यासरतात्मनाम्
21.m: nor to the disciples of others without having tested them diligently. / By all means this has been fully declared to those whose minds are devoted to the practice of yoga,

21.s:
prayatānāṃ vinītānāṃ śivaikārpitacetasām
kārtikeyātsamāsādya jñānāmṛtamidaṃ mahat
munayo yogamabhyasya parāṃ siddhimūpāgatāḥ
iti śrīmālinīvijayottare tantre trayoviṃśatitamo'dhikāraḥ
samāptaṃ cedaṃ mālinīvijayottaraṃ nāma mahātantram
21.d:
प्रयतानां विनीतानां शिवैकार्पितचेतसाम्
कार्तिकेयात्समासाद्य ज्ञानामृतमिदं महत्
मुनयो योगमभ्यस्य परां सिद्धिमूपागताः
इति श्रीमालिनीविजयोत्तरे तन्त्रे त्रयोविंशतितमोऽधिकारः
समाप्तं चेदं मालिनीविजयोत्तरं नाम महातन्त्रम्
21.m:
who are disciplined, humble, and whose thoughts are dedicated solely to Śiva. / Having obtained this great nectar of knowledge from Kārtikeya,

the sages, having practiced yoga, attained the supreme attainment.

Thus ends the twenty-third chapter in the venerable Mālinīvijayottara Tantra.

And complete is this great tantra named the Mālinīvijayottara.
